VERDICT: ACCEPT

The construction checks out. $K_{n-4}$ plus four outside vertices spanning $K_4-e$, with the stated attachments, has $(k+1)$-edge-connected degrees and crossing count $4k-1$ for the witnessing partition with $t=5$. So $\tau<k$ holds, and the edge count $\binom{n-4}{2}+4k-1$ is valid.

I also checked that this is the edge-maximal configuration. Three outside singletons fail because $m \ge p+1 = 4$ is forced but only $\binom{3}{2}=3$ edges are available. Other shapes of 4 outside vertices give at most $3k$ or $2k+2$ outside edges, below $4k-1$. Enlarging the clique is not possible, and removing one more clique vertex costs about $n-5 > k$ edges, which the extra attachments cannot recover.

The remaining uncertainty is that I did not rigorously verify that the spectral maximizer is this edge-maximal graph. The hypothesis $n \ge 3k+2$ is not obviously used in my argument, so I cannot rule out a different extremal structure for $n$ near $3k$.

CONFIDENCE: 3
